issues.issue: What standard of intervention the RAD applies to the RPD decision
issues.result_text: RAD will conduct a full independent assessment of the evidence and make its own determination.

issues.issue: Whether refusing compulsory military service is a political opinion or otherwise tied to a Convention ground
issues.applicant_position: Refusing service is a political opinion; fear of hazing creates an imputed opinion and a nexus to a Convention ground.
issues.result_text: No nexus to a Convention ground found; the claim falls under section 97, not section 96.

issues.issue: Whether the risk of hazing, abuse and military suicide in South Korea's army is a personal risk of torture or cruel treatment
issues.applicant_position: Serious risk to all conscripts; physical abuse is tolerated; military suicide rates are very high.
issues.result_text: Risk to the Appellant is not more likely than not to amount to torture or cruel treatment.

issues.issue: Whether South Korea provides adequate state protection to conscripts
issues.result_text: Presumption of adequate state protection not rebutted; authorities take significant steps against military abuse.

issues.issue: Whether imprisonment for evading service, and prison conditions, amount to cruel or unusual treatment
issues.applicant_position: The Appellant will be imprisoned for refusing service and will face abuse in prison.
issues.result_text: An eighteen-month sentence is not cruel or unusual; prison conditions meet standards; no proof of mistreatment.

issues.issue: Whether employment difficulty after refusing service is persecution
issues.applicant_position: Refusing service will make employment more difficult for the Appellant.
issues.result_text: Employment difficulty is discriminatory but does not amount to persecution.

issues.issue: Whether humanitarian circumstances (mother's trafficking victim status) can be considered
issues.applicant_position: The mother is a trafficking victim who depends on the Appellant; reasons to remain in Canada.
issues.result_text: RAD cannot consider the humanitarian situation; it is best addressed elsewhere.
